items.title: LMDeploy has an SSRF bypass
items.summary: ### Summary The URL checking logic in lmdeploy has a logical flaw that could be bypassed by attackers, leading to SSRF attacks. ### Details The current lmdeploy project uses `_is_safe_url` to validate the input URL. The main logic is to perform security checks on the host portion of the URL extracted by urlparse to prevent SSRF attacks. However, there are indeed differences in parsing between urlparse and the library that actually sends the request. Currently, almost all application scenarios in this project involve first using `_is_safe_url` for URL validation, and then using requests.Session().get to send the request. The core issue: `urlparse()` and `requests` disagree on which host a URL like `http://127.0.0.1:6666\@1.1.1.1` points to: - `urlparse()` treats `\` as a regular character and `@` as the userinfo-host delimiter, so it extracts hostname as 1.1.1.1 (public) - `requests` treats `\` as a path character, connecting to `127.0.0.1` (internal) Below is a test code I wrote following the code. ``` from urllib.parse import urlparse import ipaddress import socket import requests def _is_safe_url(url: str) -> tuple[bool, str]: """Check if the URL is safe to fetch (not internal/private).""" try: parsed = urlparse(url) if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https"): return False, f"Unsupported scheme: {parsed.scheme}" hostname = parsed.hostname if not hostname: return False, "Could not parse hostname from URL" # check all IPs (IPv4 + IPv6) using getaddrinfo try: infos = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None) except socket.gaierror: return False, "Hostname resolution failed" for info in infos: ip = ipaddress.ip_address(info[4][0]) # block any IP that is not globally routable (covers private, loopback, # link-local, multicast, reserved, unspecified, etc.) if not ip.is_global: return False, f"Blocked non-global IP detected: {ip}" return True, "URL is safe" except Exception as e: return False, f"URL validation failed: {str(e)}" # url = "http://127.0.0.1:6666" url = "http://127.0.0.1:6666\@1.1.1.1" is_safe, reason = _is_safe_url(url) if not is_safe: raise ValueError(f"URL is blocked for security reasons: {reason}") fetch_timeout = 10 client = requests.Session() client.max_redirects = 3 response = client.get(url, timeout=fetch_timeout, allow_redirects=True) ``` When an attacker uses http://127.0.0.1:6666/, the existing detection logic can detect that this is an internal network address and block it. However, when an attacker uses `http://127.0.0.1:6666\@1.1.1.1`, the detection logic resolves the host to `1.1.1.1`, which is a public IP address, thus passing the verification. But in the actual request process, this URL is forwarded by requests.get to `http://127.0.0.1:6666/`, bypassing the detection and achieving an SSRF attack. ### PoC ``` http://127.0.0.1:6666\@1.1.1.1 ``` ### Impact SSRF

items.title: Semantic MediaWiki's Special:FacetedSearch cstate hidden inputs enable reflected XSS (residual of CVE-2025-10354)
items.summary:
### Summary

Special:FacetedSearch `cstate` hidden inputs enable reflected XSS (residual of CVE-2025-10354)

### Details

#### Affected versions and vulnerable location

- Confirmed present on latest shipped release tag available in the local clone: `SemanticMediaWiki/SemanticMediaWiki@7.2.0`.
- Confirmed present on default branch `master` at HEAD `18f418b4cdf2875e67a741349179a22c1573f61c`.

Vulnerable sink (default-branch representation):

- `src/MediaWiki/Specials/FacetedSearch/HtmlBuilder.php:131-133`
  - Builds `$hidden` by concatenating unescaped request-controlled `cstate[$key]` values into an HTML attribute context (`value="..."`).
- `templates/FacetedSearch/search.mustache:25`
  - Inserts the constructed fragment via `{{{hidden}}}` (no HTML escaping at this boundary).

#### Reachability trace (verified from source)

1. HTTP entrypoint:
   - `GET` to `Special:FacetedSearch` dispatches into `SMW\MediaWiki\Specials\SpecialFacetedSearch::execute()`.
2. Request decoding boundary:
   - `SpecialFacetedSearch::execute()` constructs `UrlArgs` from `$request->getValues()` and calls `ParametersProcessor::checkRequest($request)`.
3. Checksum gate:
   - `ParametersProcessor::checkRequest()` clears `cstate` only when `filtered != 1` and `getInt('csum', 0) != crc32(getVal('q', ''))`.
4. Decoder -> HTML assembly:
   - `HtmlBuilder::buildHTML()` iterates `foreach ( $urlArgs->getArray( 'cstate' ) as $key => $value )` and concatenates each into `$hidden` without escaping.
   - `HtmlBuilder::buildHTML()` passes `$hidden` into the template variable `hidden`.
5. HTML injection sink:
   - `templates/FacetedSearch/search.mustache` renders `{{{hidden}}}` into the `<form>`, so the concatenated markup is inserted as raw HTML.

### PoC

#### Reproduction steps (source-derived)

1. Choose a `q` value.
2. Compute `csum` as `crc32(q)`.
3. Send a request that includes:
   - `q=<chosen>`
   - `csum=<crc32(q)>`
   - at least one `cstate[<key>]=<payload>` entry

Example request shape:

```text
/index.php/Special:FacetedSearch?q=Text&csum=<crc32(Text)>&cstate[0]=x%22%20autofocus%20onfocus%3Dalert(1)%20x%22
```

### Impact

#### Attacker model

- Any remote attacker who can send HTTP requests to `Special:FacetedSearch` (or the localized alias mapped to the same `SpecialFacetedSearch` class) can supply attacker-controlled query parameters.
- Preconditions:
  - The attacker must make `cstate` survive `ParametersProcessor::checkRequest()`, either by setting `csum` to `crc32(q)` (when `filtered != 1`), or by setting `filtered=1`.
  - The attacker must supply `cstate[<key>]` values containing characters that break out of the HTML `value="..."` attribute context (for example an injected `"` to terminate the attribute value).

#### Severity and CVSS reasoning

Proposed severity: MEDIUM.

Proposed CVSS v3.1 vector: `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N`.

Rationale:

- AV:N: delivered over the network via query parameters.
- AC:L: requires only setting `q`, `csum`, and at least one `cstate` entry.
- PR:N: no authentication required for the request path in this code.
- UI:R: the victim must load the crafted URL.
- S:C: reflected XSS executes in the wiki origin and can affect other users depending on deployment and browser behavior.

### Why this is a residual of CVE-2025-10354

items.title: Bridging the Opacity: Evidence-Backed Cross-Chain Transaction Correspondence Reconstruction Across Heterogeneous Blockchains
items.summary: Cross-chain bridges enable interoperability, but they also break the transaction trails needed to trace illicit funds. Third-party investigators typically cannot access the source-to-destination mappings maintained by bridge backends, and our survey of 131 bridges finds that only 16.79% provide complete public tracking. Existing approaches depend on official APIs, EVM-specific assumptions, or fragile temporal heuristics, limiting their ability to trace transfers across heterogeneous ledgers. We present XSplicer, an evidence-driven system for reconstructing cross-chain transaction correspondence (xTCR) without privileged access to bridge backends. XSplicer derives unified semantic specifications from public protocol documentation and transaction examples, translates them into lightweight parsers and verifiers, and links source and destination transactions by prioritizing hard evidence and using soft clues only when necessary. We evaluate XSplicer on seven bridge protocols spanning EVM, Bitcoin, and Solana. XSplicer achieves 92.5% global recovery rate and up to 98.61% on individual protocols. Under adversarial noise, its hard-evidence verifier retains the correct match in 100% of tested cases, while soft-clue matching degrades as ambiguity increases. In two real-world case studies, XSplicer recovers more than 1,900 historical transaction pairs after Multichain ceased operations and identifies 754 illicit cross-chain transfers worth 105.6 million USD in the Bybit laundering incident. These results show that public protocol invariants can support practical cross-chain forensics without privileged bridge mappings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 跨链桥在实现链间互操作的同时，也切断了追踪非法资金所需的交易链路。第三方调查机构通常无法访问桥后端维护的源链到目标链的映射关系；作者对 131 个跨链桥的调研发现，仅有 16.79% 提供完整的公开追踪能力。现有追踪方案依赖官方 API、EVM 特有假设或脆弱的时间启发式匹配，难以在异构账本（如 EVM、比特币、Solana）之间可靠地还原资金流向。针对这一问题，论文提出 XSplicer——一个证据驱动、无需桥后端特权访问的跨链交易对应关系重建系统（xTCR）。其核心思路是：从公开的协议文档与实际交易样例中抽取统一的语义规范，自动转译为轻量级解析器与验证器；在关联源链与目标链交易时，优先采用硬证据（如协议层面不可伪造的事件字段、哈希承诺、序列号、金额与地址约束等），仅在硬证据不足时才退回到软线索（时间窗口、金额近似、地址行为相似性等）进行匹配。作者在覆盖 EVM、比特币和 Solana 的 7 个桥协议上开展评估：全局恢复率达 92.5%，单协议最高达 98.61%。在注入对抗性噪声的条件下，硬证据验证器在全部测试用例中均保留了正确匹配，而软线索匹配的准确率随歧义增大而下降，说明分层证据策略的有效性。两个真实案例进一步验证实用性：在 Multichain 停止运营后恢复出 1900 余组历史交易对；在 Bybit 洗钱事件中识别出 754 笔非法跨链转移，涉及金额约 1.056 亿美元。结果表明，仅依靠公开协议不变量即可支撑实用的跨链取证，无需桥方提供内部映射。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 跨链桥是当前资金洗白与追赃的主要断点。该研究证明仅凭公开协议不变量即可重建源-目标交易对应关系，并在 Multichain 停运与 Bybit 洗钱等真实场景中验证，为交易所合规、链上反洗钱与执法取证提供了不依赖桥方配合的可行路径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至交易所 KYT/合规审查、执法机构被盗资金追踪、跨链桥风险评级、稳定币发行方黑名单资金流溯源，以及停运或跑路桥项目的历史资金清理等场景；对异构账本（EVM、比特币、Solana）的适配性降低了单一生态依赖。
detection_signals_zh: 桥协议公开事件日志中源链锁定/销毁与目标链铸造/释放交易之间配对缺失或延迟异常
桥后端未公开映射关系，导致公开浏览器无法端到端追踪跨链转移
同一地址或地址簇在多个桥之间进行高频、大额、短周期跨链跳跃

defense_advice_zh: 建立基于公开协议不变量的自主对账能力，将桥文档与示例交易转译为可复用的解析与校验规则库
对高价值跨链流动优先使用硬证据（协议事件字段、哈希承诺等）进行校验，软线索仅作辅助并标注置信度
在 KYT/合规流程中引入跨异构账本（EVM、比特币、Solana）的统一追踪视图，避免仅依赖单一桥方 API
对停运或跑路桥项目的历史交易进行回溯式配对重建，以补齐资金链路缺口
将跨链匹配结果与地址标签、制裁名单联动，形成可审计的取证证据链

items.title: Investigating Adversarial Robustness of Heterogeneous Cooperative Perception
items.summary: Heterogeneous cooperative perception (CP) enables connected vehicles with diverse sensor setups to share spatial awareness via compact feature maps, where receivers reconcile these maps using learned translation modules for fusion and inference. Prior attacks against CP in a homogeneous setting reveal that the data exchange introduces a critical attack surface: a single malicious agent can transmit crafted features that erase real objects from a neighbor's fused scene. Yet, it is widely hypothesized that heterogeneity naturally defends against these attacks, as the attacker lacks knowledge of the victim's detector and the translation module scrambles adversarial gradients. We demonstrate that this protection is largely an illusion. Using a matched-objective harness to standardize the perturbation budget, objective, and forward path, we show that properly tuned iterative attacks close or reverse the apparent robustness gap. However, these optimization-based attacks require ground-truth labels and iterative backpropagation, meaning they do not represent a practical field threat running in real-time. To bridge this gap, we introduce HetPoison, a learned generator that crafts a removal perturbation in a single, label-free forward pass. HetPoison transfers across major heterogeneous designs without requiring access to the victim's detector, matching or exceeding the effectiveness of expensive optimizer-based attacks. Since heterogeneity itself is not a defense, we propose HetShield, a lightweight trust layer that validates the spatiotemporal consistency across features, recovering 83--95% of the accuracy degraded by attacks, outperforming prior art.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究异构协同感知（Heterogeneous Cooperative Perception, CP）的对抗鲁棒性问题。在此类系统中，传感器配置各异的联网车辆通过紧凑特征图共享空间感知，接收方使用学习到的翻译模块（translation module）对齐来自不同来源的特征，再进行融合与推理。此前针对同构 CP 的攻击已表明，数据交换环节构成关键攻击面：单个恶意代理即可发送精心构造的特征，从邻居的融合场景中“抹除”真实存在的目标。学界普遍假设异构性本身即是一种天然防御——攻击者不了解受害方的检测器结构，且翻译模块会打乱对抗梯度，使攻击难以奏效。作者通过实验证明这种保护基本是错觉：他们设计了一个 matched-objective 测试框架，统一扰动预算、优化目标与前向路径，从而消除评测口径差异，结果显示经过恰当调参的迭代式攻击可以缩小甚至逆转表面上存在的鲁棒性差距。但作者同时指出，这类基于优化的攻击依赖真实标注（ground-truth）且需要迭代反向传播，计算开销大，不构成可实时运行的现实野外威胁。为填补这一落差，作者提出 HetPoison——一个可学习的生成器，只需一次无标签前向传播即可生成目标移除扰动，无需访问受害方检测器即可跨主流异构设计迁移，效果与昂贵的优化器攻击持平甚至更优。基于“异构不等于防御”的结论，作者进一步提出 HetShield：一个轻量级信任层，通过校验特征间的时空一致性来识别异常，可恢复被攻击削弱的准确率的 83%–95%，性能优于现有方案。整体上，论文重新评估了异构 CP 的安全假设，并提供了攻击面量化方法与可落地的防御层设计，适合自动驾驶、车路协同（V2X）安全、以及多智能体感知融合方向的研究者与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自动驾驶与车路协同长期把“异构传感器配置”当作天然安全边界，本文证明该假设不成立，且攻击者无需受害方检测器知识、单次前向即可实施目标移除。安全团队需重新评估协同感知的信任模型。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用特征级协同感知的自动驾驶/车联网部署，以及任何跨实体共享中间表征的联邦式感知系统；HetShield 的一致性校验思路可迁移到多源特征融合、模型供应链与多智能体协作场景。
detection_signals_zh: 融合前后目标数量/位置在同一时间窗内出现与原始观测不符的突变（目标被抹除）
单个协作方上报的特征图与邻居自车观测在同一空间区域持续冲突
协作方特征在时空一致性校验（跨帧、跨视角）中置信度异常偏低
某协作节点的特征分布与同类异构配置的历史基线出现显著偏移
defense_advice_zh: 不要把传感器异构性视为防御手段，按同构威胁模型同等对待异构协同感知链路
在特征融合前部署轻量级信任层，对特征做时空一致性校验与来源信誉评分
对协作方实施身份认证与权限绑定，限制单节点可影响的融合范围
在红队评估中采用统一扰动预算与目标函数的评测框架，避免高估现有鲁棒性
对特征交换链路做完整性监测与日志留存，便于事后溯源与取证

items.title: Reachability, Not Observation: Containing Systems Whose Wiring Changes
items.summary: Containment decisions -- where to put a firewall, which links to monitor, what a program may reach -- are computed from an observed structure, and observation is a snapshot. We ask what a snapshot misses when the wiring changes over time. On a hypercube whose active dimension rotates, a balanced split shows zero crossing edges at 93% of instants, yet 8,192 edges must be blocked permanently; adding one always-on ring, a defender sees 2 where 8,194 must be blocked, a factor of 4,097. A time-aware defender holds 585 blocks on average, but one step of clock lag drops its containment to 0%. On the real Internet the same gap is only x1.8-2.0 (1997-2000) and x1.5-1.6 (2024-2026) once growth is removed, so the blind spot is introduced by design, not inherited from the world -- and it has been designed: the round-robin schedules of optical datacentre fabrics have a gap equal to their period. A declared capability map, checked by static reachability over a real application's call graph, catches all 8 planted holes; the string deny-list previously in place catches 2. One calculation generates every number from one parameter, the period, and reads three boundaries not usually called schedules: frequency hopping, whose standard results are these closed forms with channels in place of edges; the air gap, whose always-on crossing set is empty and whose known breach came at the one phase a snapshot misses; and the tool surface of a coding agent, inventoried from the inside. Turning the cuts on that agent: idle, its instantaneous state cut is zero, while 6 channels carry it across a context reset, none of them the network, so severing the network removes 0. The channel that spawns copies is a branching process with a sharp threshold at approval rate 1/b, below which denial is unnecessary and above which denial is insufficient. Contain by the paths that exist, not by the behaviour that was seen.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究「围堵决策」（防火墙放在哪、监控哪些链路、程序能到达什么）的一个根本性盲点：决策通常基于一次性观测到的结构，而观测只是快照，一旦系统的连接关系（wiring）随时间变化，快照就会漏掉关键信息。作者用可精确计算的模型量化这一缺口：在活跃维度轮转的超立方体上，一个平衡分割在 93% 的时刻看起来跨边为零，但实际必须永久阻断 8,192 条边；再增加一个始终在线的环后，防御者只看到 2 条需要阻断，而真实值是 8,194 条，相差 4,097 倍。时间感知的防御者平均只需维持 585 个阻断，但时钟滞后一步就会让围堵覆盖率跌到 0%。作者进一步指出，在真实互联网上剔除增长因素后，这一差距只有 1.8–2.0 倍（1997–2000）与 1.5–1.6 倍（2024–2026），因此该盲区不是客观世界固有的，而是设计引入的——并且确实已经被设计出来：光数据中心交换网络的轮询调度，其快照盲区恰好等于其调度周期。作为对策，作者提出用「声明式能力图谱」配合对真实应用调用图的静态可达性检查，能捕获全部 8 个植入的漏洞，而此前使用的字符串拒绝列表只能捕获 2 个。整个模型只需一个参数（周期）即可生成全部数值。作者还把同一套分析推广到三个通常不被称作「调度」的边界：跳频（其标准结论正是这些闭式解，只是把「边」换成「信道」）；气隙（其始终在线的跨越集为空，而已知的突破恰恰发生在一个被快照漏掉的相位上）；以及编码智能体的工具面（从内部清点）。对编码智能体施加割集分析：空闲时其瞬时状态割为零，但有 6 条信道能在上下文重置时把状态带过去，且没有一条是网络，因此切断网络能移除的暴露为 0。生成副本的信道是一个分支过程，在批准率 1/b 处存在尖锐阈值：低于该值时无需拒绝，高于该值时拒绝也不充分。核心结论是：围堵应当依据实际存在的路径（可达性），而不是依据曾经观察到的行为。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它用可计算模型证明基于单次快照的围堵会在时变拓扑下被严重低估，并指出轮询调度、跳频、气隙与 AI 智能体工具面共享同一失效模式，直接关系到分段、监控点与智能体权限设计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到数据中心光交换/轮询调度网络的防火墙与监控布点、跳频通信的频段管控、气隙网络的跨域隔离评估，以及 AI 编码智能体的工具面与上下文重置信道管控；也提示以静态可达性/调用图分析替代字符串拒绝列表做能力审计。
detection_signals_zh: 单次网络/拓扑快照与跨周期相位采样结果不一致，出现大量仅在特定时刻可见的可达路径

items.title: Characterizing Network Centralization and Observability in the Remote MCP Ecosystem
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as the dominant interface for connecting autonomous agents to external data sources and execution environments. The ecosystem's transition from local process execution to remote Streamable HTTP deployments introduces unmeasured architectural and security constraints at scale. This paper presents a three-tier observability framework comprising catalog metadata (O_0), passive compliance signals (O_1), and live vulnerability analysis (O_2), applied to empirically characterize the public MCP server ecosystem. Evaluation of a stratified sample of 179 remote endpoints across two primary public registries reveals significant infrastructural consolidation. The Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) computed over the Autonomous System Number (ASN) distribution yields a value of 0.736, well above the 0.25 threshold for a highly concentrated market. Analysis further indicates that server authentication is strongly correlated with hosting platform choice rather than individual operator configuration, with 95\% of commercial PaaS-hosted servers enforcing gateway-level OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. The empirical results identify a Security-Observability Tradeoff observed in the current ecosystem: the platform-level authentication mechanisms that secure the majority of servers simultaneously limit automated vulnerability scanning capabilities, constraining the ability of AI gateway operators to assess tool-poisoning vectors without prior credential provisioning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对快速扩张的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 生态进行了一次大规模的实证测绘研究。MCP 已成为自主智能体连接外部数据源与执行环境的主流接口，而其部署形态正从本地进程调用迁移到远程 Streamable HTTP 服务。作者指出，这种迁移带来了此前未被量化的大规模架构与安全约束。为系统性地刻画该生态，论文提出一个三层可观测性框架：O_0 层为目录元数据（注册表中公开的服务器条目、运营方、端点地址等）；O_1 层为被动合规信号（无需认证即可观察到的协议版本、鉴权头、网关行为等）；O_2 层为主动漏洞分析（需在获得凭据或授权后方可进行的深度检测）。作者从两个主要公共 MCP 注册表中抽取分层样本，对 179 个远程端点进行了实测。结果显示该生态存在显著的基础设施集中化：按自治系统号 (ASN) 分布计算的 Herfindahl-Hirschman 指数 (HHI) 达到 0.736，远高于判定为高度集中市场的 0.25 门槛，意味着少数 ASN/云平台承载了绝大多数远程 MCP 服务，一旦某一平台出现故障、策略变更或被攻击，影响面将呈放大效应。研究还发现，服务器的认证配置与所选托管平台强相关，而非由单个运营方自行决定：托管在商业 PaaS 上的服务器中有 95% 在网关层强制实施带 PKCE 的 OAuth 2.1。基于此，论文提出当前生态中存在一个'安全—可观测性权衡'：正是这些保护多数服务器的平台级认证机制，同时限制了自动化漏洞扫描能力，使 AI 网关运营方在没有预先获得凭据的情况下，难以评估工具投毒 (tool-poisoning) 等风险向量。论文的贡献在于：首次以可复现的度量方法量化远程 MCP 生态的集中度与认证同质性；提出可分层复用的可观测性框架；并明确指出集中化与认证强绑定共同构成的系统性风险，以及安全加固与安全评估之间的结构性矛盾。适合 AI 网关/平台工程团队、智能体生态安全研究者、云与供应链风险管理者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 远程 MCP 是当前智能体接入外部工具的主通道，而本文量化出的 ASN 高度集中 (HHI 0.736) 意味着少数云平台构成系统性单点，其故障或策略变更会级联影响大量智能体。同时它揭示了平台级 OAuth 2.1 加固反过来阻碍第三方漏洞扫描的结构性矛盾，直接关系到网关运营方的风险可视性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到企业自建或采购 MCP 网关的资产盘点与供应链风险评估：识别自身依赖的 ASN/托管平台集中度、评估单平台故障与合规变更的爆炸半径、并在采购与安全测试合同中提前约定凭据供给与扫描授权，以避免'安全加固导致不可评估'的困境。
detection_signals_zh: 对内部登记的远程 MCP 端点按 ASN、云厂商、证书签发者做聚合统计，观察集中度指标 (如 HHI) 是否超过预警阈值
被动采集未认证即可观察的信号：协议版本、网关返回的鉴权挑战类型、是否提示 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE
持续比对公共注册表目录元数据 (O_0) 与实测端点行为 (O_1) 的偏差，例如条目声明的能力与实际响应不一致
监控同一 ASN 或同一 PaaS 网关下大量 MCP 服务的同时性可用性波动，作为平台级事件的前兆
defense_advice_zh: 建立远程 MCP 服务台账，记录注册表来源、运营方、托管平台、ASN 与认证方式，定期复核归属变化
对集中度过高的托管平台制定多平台冗余或降级预案，避免单一 ASN 事件导致智能体工具链整体失效
在接入第三方 MCP 服务前，通过合同或技术流程明确安全评估所需的凭据供给与授权范围，缓解安全—可观测性权衡
优先选择公开工具清单、版本与变更日志可核验的服务，对工具描述与权限范围做人工复核，降低工具投毒风险
把 MCP 网关纳入既有供应链与云风险管理流程，定期评估平台级策略变更对自身智能体工作流的影响
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部评估 (对自有 MCP 端点做一次 ASN 集中度与认证方式盘点)

items.title: Locus: A Framework for Exploring and Optimizing Point Addition Hardware for Zero-Knowledge Proofs
items.summary: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) are critical for privacy-preserving and verifiable computation, but their cryptographic primitives impose high computational overheads. One such primitive is point addition (PADD) on elliptic curves. Several prior works have implemented PADDs in hardware, but only for a few specific elliptic curves and design points, leaving a large design space unexplored, and lacking systematic guidance on hardware design trade-offs. To address this gap, we present Locus, a framework dedicated to optimizing and exploring point addition hardware. Given the parameters of any elliptic curve in a supported equation form, Locus automatically generates ASIC and FPGA implementations of PADD, enabling systematic exploration of the PADD design space. Using Locus, we conduct the first comprehensive hardware-focused study of PADD designs, exploring trade-offs over 1,000 design points. On a 12nm technology node, our framework produces PADD designs that yield a $2.71\times$ geomean speedup and $3.11\times$ geomean area reduction compared to prior ASICs, $34.67\times$ geomean speedup over CPU, and $3.15\times$ geomean speedup on end-to-end proof generation when integrated into a prior ZKP accelerator at iso-area. Locus is available at https://github.com/cryptolets/cryptolets/tree/locus.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 零知识证明（ZKP）在隐私保护与可验证计算场景中至关重要，但其底层密码学原语计算开销极高，其中椭圆曲线上的点加法（PADD）是关键原语之一。已有工作在硬件层面实现了 PADD 加速，但普遍只覆盖少数特定椭圆曲线和少量固定设计点，导致庞大的设计空间未被系统探索，也缺乏关于硬件设计折衷（速度、面积、功耗、频率等）的系统性指导。针对这一空白，作者提出 Locus —— 一个专门用于优化与探索点加法硬件的自动化框架。Locus 的输入是受支持方程形式（如 Weierstrass 等形式）下任意椭圆曲线的参数，它能够自动生成对应的 ASIC 与 FPGA 版 PADD 实现，从而让设计者系统性地遍历和评估 PADD 设计空间，而不必为每条曲线手工重写 RTL。基于该框架，作者首次开展了以硬件为中心的 PADD 设计全面研究，覆盖超过 1000 个设计点，刻画了不同曲线参数与微架构选择对面积、延迟、吞吐等指标的影响。在 12nm 工艺节点上，Locus 生成的 PADD 设计相较此前的 ASIC 实现取得几何平均 2.71 倍加速与 3.11 倍面积缩减；相较 CPU 实现获得几何平均 34.67 倍加速；在等面积条件下集成进已有 ZKP 加速器后，端到端证明生成获得几何平均 3.15 倍加速。框架代码已在 GitHub 上以 locus 分支开源，供学术界与工业界复用和扩展。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ZKP 加速是隐私计算与链上验证的性能瓶颈，本文把点加法硬件从“逐曲线手工设计”推进到“参数化自动生成+千点级设计空间探索”，并给出可复现的 ASIC/FPGA 生成框架与开源实现。对做硬件加速、密码工程与 ZKP 性能优化的团队具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 ZKP 加速器、ASIC/FPGA 密码算子库、隐私计算与区块链验证节点的硬件选型与面积-性能权衡评估；也可为其他椭圆曲线族或类似有限域算术算子提供自动生成与设计空间探索的方法论模板。
defense_advice_zh: 关注该框架的自动生成流程与开源实现，评估其是否可用于内部密码加速器 PPA 建模与设计点筛选
在评估 ZKP 加速方案时，将椭圆曲线参数与硬件微架构选择纳入统一权衡矩阵，而非仅比较单一设计点数据
注意公开硬件生成器可能带来的设计复用与供应链可追溯性问题，纳入硬件物料与 IP 审查流程
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Ghost-Filled Orders: Detecting and Testing Atomicity Violations in Non-Custodial Prediction Markets
items.summary: Blockchain based prediction markets combine offchain order management with onchain settlement. This architecture supports user controlled custody, since users keep funds in wallets or smart contracts while submitting signed orders to an offchain order book. However, it creates an atomicity gap. An order may be valid when accepted or matched offchain, but become invalid before the corresponding onchain settlement transaction is executed. This behavior, often called ghost filled orders by the community, can cause trades that appear filled offchain to fail onchain. This paper studies this atomicity gap through a case study of Polymarket. We show how the delay between offchain order acceptance and onchain settlement allows adversaries to invalidate unfavorable orders after observing market outcomes or price movements. We then quantify the scale and financial impact of this behavior over a nine-month period from August 12, 2025, to May 22, 2026, using 1.8 million reverted transactions involving Polymarket official smart contracts. Our analysis separates attacker profit from market and user loss, and develops conservative measurement rules to avoid overclaiming impact. We further develop a methodology for testing other blockchain based prediction markets and apply it to three additional markets. We find that all three are vulnerable to the same class of attack, and that one design enables direct attacker profit. We have reported the findings to all three projects; one project had acknowledged the issue at the time of the study.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究区块链预测市场中由「链上结算 + 链下订单簿」混合架构引入的原子性缺口问题。此类市场为兼顾用户自托管（用户资金始终留在自己的钱包或智能合约中），采用链下撮合、链上结算的模式：用户签署订单并提交至链下订单簿，订单在链下被接受或撮合时是有效的，但等到对应的链上结算交易真正执行时，订单可能已经失效。社区将这种现象称为「幽灵成交订单（ghost-filled orders）」——链下显示已成交，链上却结算失败。作者认为该现象并非偶发故障，而是架构层面的原子性缺陷：链下接受订单与链上结算之间存在时间窗口，掌握该窗口的一方可以在观察到市场结果或价格变动后，使对自己不利的订单失效，从而形成一种信息与执行时序上的优势。论文以 Polymarket 为案例展开实证研究，量化该行为的规模与财务影响：作者收集并分析了 2025 年 8 月 12 日至 2026 年 5 月 22 日共九个月间涉及 Polymarket 官方智能合约的约 180 万笔回滚（reverted）交易，并将攻击者获利与市场、普通用户损失分别归因，同时设计了一套偏保守的度量规则，以避免高估实际影响。在方法论层面，论文进一步抽象出可用于测试其他区块链预测市场是否易受同类问题影响的方法，并应用于另外三个市场；结果显示三者均存在同类原子性缺口，且其中一个市场因设计差异可使攻击者直接获利。作者已将发现披露给三个项目，其中一家在研究进行时已确认该问题。整体而言，这是一篇结合实证测量与架构安全分析的论文，适合关注区块链金融基础设施、MEV/交易排序、链下链上协同安全以及预测市场设计的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示「链下撮合+链上结算」这一广泛采用的架构存在系统性原子性缺口，并非单一项目缺陷；论文以百万级真实回滚交易量化损失，并把检测方法迁移验证到另外三个预测市场，对交易类 DeFi 系统的时序安全设计具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用链下订单簿与链上结算分离架构的预测市场及类似交易系统（含衍生品、订单簿型 DEX）；可迁移场景包括订单有效性校验、结算前状态重验、订单生命周期一致性审计，以及针对大规模回滚交易的链上监控与归因分析。
detection_signals_zh: 官方结算合约上大量 reverted 交易，且集中在行情剧烈波动或结果明确之后的时间段
同一批订单在链下显示已撮合，但对应链上结算交易反复失败
订单失效/取消与结算尝试之间存在异常短的时间间隔，呈现跟随市场走势的时序模式
特定地址持续产生高回滚率结算交易，同时链下成交记录正常
结算失败率与市场波动率、临近结算时点呈现相关性
defense_advice_zh: 在链上结算前对订单有效性做二次校验，缩短或显式约束链下接受到链上执行的信任窗口
对订单引入不可随意撤销的锁定机制或抵押/罚没设计，使事后失效具有成本
建立回滚交易与链下成交记录的差异对账，作为常态化监控指标
将回滚率、结算失败窗口纳入市场运营方的风险指标与告警阈值
对新上线预测市场按论文方法论做上线前原子性缺口评估
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: JANUS: Denial-of-Service Attack Against Beam Hopping in LEO Satellite Networks
items.summary: Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks are increasingly used to provide global connectivity. However, each satellite has limited resources that need to be allocated according to demand, which varies geographically and over time. Beam hopping addresses this challenge by dividing a satellite's service area into geographic cells. Rather than illuminating every cell simultaneously, it dynamically assigns available beams to a selected subset based on demand. This reliance on observed traffic demand as an input to beam-selection decisions creates a new attack surface whose security implications have received little attention. In this paper, we present JANUS, a novel targeted denial-of-service attack against beam-hopping systems in LEO networks. We show that a small botnet of compromised terminals can inject legitimate user traffic into carefully selected non-victim cells to manipulate the beam-hopping scheduler's view of demand. This manipulation alters beam-allocation decisions and redirects service away from the targeted victim area. We evaluate JANUS across different system configurations, schedulers, attack horizons, and attacker-knowledge settings to characterize the attack's effectiveness, required resources, and resulting service disruption over time. Against a rank-based KMAX scheduler, JANUS achieves complete service denial for up to approximately 95% of evaluated victims. Against DRL, JANUS can exclude the victim from approximately 92% of scheduling decisions. Finally, we evaluate mitigation strategies that reduce the attack effectiveness.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 低轨（LEO）卫星星座正成为全球互联网接入的重要基础设施，但单星功率、带宽与波束资源有限，而地面业务需求在空间与时间上分布极不均匀。波束跳变（beam hopping）技术通过把卫星覆盖区划分成多个地理小区，不再同时照射所有小区，而是依据观测到的业务需求动态将有限波束分配给需求较高的子集，以提升资源利用率。本文指出：恰恰是“把观测到的需求作为调度输入”这一设计，构成了此前鲜被关注的新攻击面。作者提出 JANUS——一种针对 LEO 波束跳变系统的定向拒绝服务攻击。其核心思路是：由少量被控终端组成的僵尸网络，向精心挑选的非受害小区注入看似合法的用户流量，从而改变调度器对全局需求分布的认知，使波束分配决策偏离受害区域，最终造成目标区域服务中断。论文在多种系统配置、调度算法、攻击时间跨度与攻击者知识水平下评估了攻击的有效性、所需资源规模以及随时间推移造成的服务降级程度。结果显示：在基于排序的 KMAX 调度器上，JANUS 可对约 95% 的受害目标实现完全服务拒绝；在深度强化学习（DRL）调度器上，可使受害小区被排除在约 92% 的调度决策之外。论文最后评估了若干缓解策略及其降低攻击有效性的程度。该研究适合卫星网络安全、空天信息系统、调度与资源分配算法方向的研究者与运营方阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作揭示波束调度器把“观测/上报需求”当作可信输入的隐含信任假设：攻击者无需利用任何软件漏洞，仅凭小规模被控终端注入合法流量即可制造服务中断。对卫星运营商、调度器设计者及关键基础设施安全团队具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响低轨卫星宽带运营商的波束调度、容量分配与服务可用性。其“污染需求输入导致资源错配”的思路可迁移到 5G/蜂窝切片调度、Wi-Fi 与星地融合网络、CDN 调度、云负载均衡等一切以观测指标为决策依据的资源系统。
detection_signals_zh: 非受害小区出现与本地真实用户分布不匹配的流量激增，且发起终端归属波位或地理位置异常
波束分配决策在短时间内向特定小区集中，同时受害小区的吞吐、接入成功率、时延等指标骤降
大量终端呈现高度同步、协同的流量发起模式（时间相关性强、目标小区高度重叠）
调度器输入的需求估计与后端真实会话、鉴权或计费数据出现系统性偏差
同一批终端反复出现在与其注册/订阅位置不符的波位，行为偏离历史基线
defense_advice_zh: 对终端上报与接入需求做交叉校验：结合归属波位、历史行为、鉴权与计费真实性，降低单点需求污染的可信度
在调度器中引入需求平滑、滞回、随机化与鲁棒优化，减小局部需求扰动对全局波束分配的影响
对协同流量模式做异常检测与终端信誉评分，必要时对可疑终端限速、降级或隔离
建立波束分配与服务质量的常态基线，对偏离基线的分配偏移和服务降级自动告警
在系统设计与采购阶段开展红队评估，把“需求侧污染”显式纳入威胁模型，并验证缓解措施的实际有效性

items.why_it_matters: 该工作揭示波束调度器把“观测/上报需求”当作可信输入的隐含信任假设：攻击者无需利用任何软件漏洞，仅凭小规模被控终端注入合法流量即可制造服务中断。对卫星运营商、调度器设计者及关键基础设施安全团队具有直接参考价值。

items.title: Sybil-TraceGuard: Traceability-enhanced Sybil Guardian for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles Using Dynamic Semi-supervised GNN
items.summary: Connected and autonomous vehicles (CAVs) face severe Sybil attacks, where attackers exploit privacy-preserving pseudonym-switching mechanisms to anomaly alternate identities while forging Basic Safety Messages (BSMs). Although existing schemes can flag suspicious behaviors, these temporally fragmented Sybil identities render traditional single-point and sequence-based deep learning methods ineffective. Linking these fragmented identities back to the source attacker is essential for root-cause elimination, particularly under extreme label scarcity. Therefore, the Sybil-TraceGuard is proposed as a dynamic semi-supervised spatio-temporal GNN framework for Sybil Guardian, prioritizing "who is responsible" over "whether an attack is happening". It comprises four tightly coupled modules: Incremental Stream Attack Detection (ISAD) for efficient Sybil attack pre-screening; the Dynamic Topology-aware Constructor (DTC) for constructing spatio-temporal dynamic graphs; the Spatial GAT-Encoder with Multi-head Attention (SGEM) to capture multi-identity logical conflicts in spatial interactions; and the Multi-scale Spatio-Temporal Audit (MSTA) to audit short-term and long-term temporal inconsistencies. These modules are optimized within a semi-supervised Mean-Teacher framework via feature-edge shuffling perturbations, regularizing the latent feature space using minimal labels. Experiments across four Sybil attack scenarios demonstrate that Sybil-TraceGuard effectively links fragmented pseudonyms to source attackers. It outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across unlabeled ratios of 0.70-0.95, maintaining high stability and sensitivity despite extreme class imbalance and varying hyperparameter settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文关注车联网（Connected and Autonomous Vehicles, CAV）场景下的 Sybil 攻击问题：攻击者利用车辆网络隐私保护中的假名切换（pseudonym-switching）机制，不断更换或交替使用多个虚假身份，并以这些身份伪造基本安全消息（Basic Safety Messages, BSM），从而在路侧与车端造成虚假交通态势、干扰协同决策。已有方案大多只能标记出可疑行为或可疑身份，但这些 Sybil 身份在时间维度上高度碎片化，导致传统的单点检测方法和基于序列的深度学习方法难以奏效。论文强调，仅仅判断“是否发生攻击”不足以从根源上消除威胁，更关键的是把这些碎片化的假名身份关联回真正的源头攻击者，即回答“谁应当为此负责”；而在真实车联网中，带标签的恶意样本极度稀缺，使这一溯源任务更加困难。

为此作者提出 Sybil-TraceGuard，一个面向 Sybil 溯源的动态半监督时空图神经网络框架。该框架由四个紧耦合模块构成：增量流式攻击检测（ISAD）用于高效地对 Sybil 攻击进行预筛选，降低后续处理开销；动态拓扑感知构造器（DTC）负责构建随时间演化的时空动态图，将车辆交互关系建模为图结构；带多头注意力的空间 GAT 编码器（SGEM）用于在空间交互中捕捉同一攻击者控制多个身份时产生的逻辑冲突；多尺度时空审计（MSTA）则从短期与长期两个时间尺度审视身份行为的时间不一致性。上述模块被统一放置在半监督 Mean-Teacher 框架中，借助特征-边混洗（feature-edge shuffling）扰动来正则化潜在特征空间，从而在仅有极少标签的条件下仍能学习到有判别力的身份表示。

实验部分覆盖四种 Sybil 攻击场景，结果表明 Sybil-TraceGuard 能有效将碎片化假名关联到源头攻击者，在无标签比例达到 0.70-0.95 的条件下仍优于当前最先进的基线方法，并在极端类别不平衡以及不同超参数设置下保持较高的稳定性与敏感性。总体来看，该工作把车联网 Sybil 防御从“攻击检测”推进到“攻击溯源”，为标签稀缺条件下的身份关联与根因定位提供了一条图学习与半监督学习相结合的技术路线。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 车联网 Sybil 攻击检测长期受限于假名频繁切换导致的身份碎片化，单点或序列模型难以关联到真实攻击者。该工作将目标从“是否被攻击”转向“谁在攻击”，并用半监督时空图学习缓解标签稀缺，对车联网安全运营与取证溯源具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至车联网 V2X 异常检测、假名/匿名身份关联、多身份协同欺诈溯源、以及标签稀缺条件下的半监督图异常检测场景；也可为车端/路侧安全运营平台的身份级溯源模块设计提供架构参考。
detection_signals_zh: 同一物理车辆在空间上不可能同时出现的位置却上报多条 BSM，形成空间交互逻辑冲突
假名切换后行为模式与切换前高度相似，构成跨身份的时空一致性线索
短期时间窗口内的消息节奏、轨迹与长期历史模式出现明显不一致
多个身份之间存在拓扑邻接关系异常密集或异常规律的交互模式
defense_advice_zh: 在车联网安全运营中引入身份级溯源思路，而非仅做单条消息或单车异常判定
建设时空动态图表示能力，将假名、位置、时间、消息内容统一建模以支撑跨身份关联
针对标签稀缺现实，评估半监督/自监督训练策略，降低对人工标注恶意样本的依赖
在部署前关注极端类别不平衡与无标签比例较高时的模型稳定性与误报控制
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: FoundAna: A GNN-assisted Foundation Model for Graph Anomaly Detection
items.summary: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify graph structures (e.g., nodes, edges, or subgraphs) that deviate significantly from expected patterns, which supports critical applications in fraud detection, spam identification, network intrusion, etc. Despite the growing methods in the field, existing approaches follow a one-model-per-dataset paradigm, limiting their transferability across diverse real-world scenarios due to task heterogeneity, label scarcity, and domain variability. In this work, we introduce FoundAna, a GNN-assisted Foundation Model for Graph Anomaly Detection - the first foundation model framework designated for generalizable, cross-graph anomaly detection by combining GNNs and transformers. FoundAna integrates an anomaly detection-specific GNN component with a standard transformer encoder augmented by four complementary positional encodings, which enable the model to capture both local and global structural information. Specifically, the positional encoding enriched node representations are passed through attribute and adjacency decoders, and the reconstruction errors serve as the anomaly score. Extensive experiments on nine benchmark datasets spanning financial, social, and citation network domains demonstrate that FoundAna consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The code implementation and Supplementary materials are here: https://github.com/FoundAna331/FoundAna.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦图异常检测 (Graph Anomaly Detection, GAD) 这一支撑欺诈识别、垃圾信息治理与网络入侵检测等关键场景的任务。作者指出，尽管近年来方法层出不穷，但现有方案普遍遵循「一个数据集训练一个模型」的范式：模型与特定图数据强绑定，面对任务异质性、标签稀缺和领域差异时迁移能力很差，难以在真实的多场景中复用。为此，作者提出 FoundAna——一个由 GNN 辅助的基础模型 (Foundation Model) 框架，声称是首个面向可泛化、跨图异常检测的基础模型方案，其核心思路是把图神经网络与 Transformer 结合。架构上，FoundAna 集成一个面向异常检测任务定制的 GNN 组件，并搭配标准 Transformer 编码器，同时引入四种互补的位置编码，使模型能够同时捕获局部与全局的结构信息。具体流程是：经位置编码增强的节点表示被送入属性解码器 (attribute decoder) 与邻接解码器 (adjacency decoder)，通过重建误差计算异常分数，从而摆脱对大量异常标签的依赖。实验方面，作者在覆盖金融、社交和引文网络三大领域的九个基准数据集上进行评估，结果显示 FoundAna 一致优于当前最先进的基线方法。论文同时公开了代码实现与补充材料，便于复现与后续研究。适合谁读：从事图机器学习、异常检测、反欺诈与网络入侵检测的研究者与工程团队。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 欺诈、垃圾信息与入侵检测大量依赖图结构分析，但传统方案每个场景都要重新标注与训练，成本高、迁移差。FoundAna 若可跨图泛化，将显著降低企业构建异常检测能力的门槛，值得防御方评估其作为统一异常打分骨干的可行性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至金融交易反欺诈、社交机器人/垃圾账号识别、引文与关系网络异常发现，以及基于通信图或实体关系图的网络入侵与横向移动检测；同时提示防御方可复用「重建误差即异常分数」的无监督/弱监督范式以缓解标签稀缺问题。注意：模型亦可被攻击方用于探测目标系统的图结构规律，存在潜在的双用途风险。
detection_signals_zh: 图数据上重建误差（异常分数）分布出现突发性偏移或簇状聚集，可能指示新型欺诈或入侵模式
同一实体子图在跨域推理中出现异常高分的连边或节点群，可作为人工复核的线索
对异常检测模型接口的高频批量查询或探测性输入，可能意味着攻击者在做规避验证
开源模型权重与推理服务的来源、版本与完整性异常
defense_advice_zh: 优先在内部已有图数据（交易、登录、通信、权限关系）上做迁移评估，验证跨域泛化是否成立再纳入生产
将模型输出作为风险打分信号而非唯一判据，保留规则引擎与人工复核的回退路径
对异常分数设置分级阈值并建立漂移监控，防止域变化导致漏报或告警洪水
对模型权重、代码仓库与推理服务做供应链校验，避免引入被篡改的第三方实现
关注该模型可能被对手用于探测或规避检测的双用途风险，必要时加入对抗性图结构评估
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：阅读原文与开源实现，评估在自有图数据上的迁移效果后再决定是否纳入内部试点。

items.title: Closing the Loop: Bidirectional Fully Encrypted Protocols
items.summary: Fully encrypted protocols (FEPs) provide encrypted channels that make all protocol-generated bytes computationally indistinguishable from uniform random strings. Several previous works have explored security definitions and constructions of unidirectional FEPs: protocols in which one party acts only as a sender, and the other acts only as a receiver. However, most applications require two-way information exchange, and a network adversary can observe communication in both directions and their shared lifetime. Because the semantics of bidirectional channels involve more complex shared state, it is possible that the ``naïve'' composition of two unidirectional channels can result in a two-way protocol that can be detected based on dependencies between the two directions, such as traffic imbalance, channel closure, failures, or connection tear-down. To address this issue, we introduce new formal security definitions for bidirectional FEPs that capture exact shaping, delivery, protocol-state integrity, private half-close, and cross-direction isolation, while revealing a public ``sending schedule'' and ``closing epoch'' that may be randomized. We show that the trivial composition fails to meet these definitions, leading to practical detection attacks. We then construct provably secure bidirectional FEPs (BiFEPs) for both the datastream and datagram settings. For datastream, we combine two direction-separated FEPs with a ``wrapper'' layer that prevents detection based on the mismatch between uni- and bi-directional connection states. For datagram, we add encrypted DATA/FIN/ACK with replay protection and loss-tolerant close. We validate the design through a Rust implementation and show that none of the surveyed deployed protocols provides the full set of BiFEP security properties.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 全加密协议(FEP,Fully Encrypted Protocols)旨在提供一种信道:协议自身产生的全部字节在计算上与均匀随机串不可区分,从而使网络观察者无法借助协议指纹、头部结构或长度特征区分该流量与随机噪声。这类协议是抗审查与抗流量分析系统的重要构件。此前的研究主要围绕单向 FEP 展开,即一方只发送、另一方只接收的场景,并给出了相应的安全定义与构造。然而现实应用几乎都需要双向信息交换,而网络对手可以同时观察两个方向的流量以及连接的共同生命周期。作者指出,把两个单向 FEP "朴素组合"成双向协议并不安全:由于双向信道涉及更复杂的共享状态,两个方向之间存在可被利用的依赖关系,例如流量不平衡、通道关闭、传输失败或连接拆除,观察者可据此判定该连接属于某种被封装协议,而非真正的随机流量,从而形成实际可用的检测攻击。为此,论文首先提出了一套面向双向 FEP 的形式化安全定义,涵盖精确整形(exact shaping)、投递保证、协议状态完整性、私有半关闭(private half-close)与跨方向隔离(cross-direction isolation),同时允许协议公开一个可随机化的"发送时间表"和"关闭纪元"。作者证明平凡组合无法满足这些定义,并解释了其导致的检测后果。随后论文分别在数据流(datastream)与数据报(datagram)两种场景下构造了可证明安全的双向全加密协议(BiFEP):数据流方案将两个方向隔离的 FEP 与一个"包装层"结合,用于消除单向与双向连接状态不匹配所泄露的差异;数据报方案则引入加密的 DATA/FIN/ACK 消息,配合重放保护与容忍丢包的关闭机制。作者用 Rust 实现了该设计,并调研了现网已部署协议,结果显示没有任何一个被调研的协议同时具备完整的 BiFEP 安全属性。该工作适合抗审查协议设计者、流量分析抵抗研究者以及隐私网络工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 许多抗审查系统依赖单向 FEP 的简单拼接,而本文证明这种组合会因双向状态依赖(流量不平衡、关闭时序、拆除行为)被检测。它给出了可证明安全的双向设计基准,值得隐私网络与流量分析防御方重新评估现有隧道协议。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响抗审查/匿名通信协议、VPN 与混淆隧道的设计评审;其形式化定义可迁移到对现网隧道协议做"双向可检测性"评估,也可作为流量分类防御方的对抗基线。
detection_signals_zh: 连接双向流量比例长期异常,与任一方宣称的应用语义不符
连接关闭/半关闭时序与随机化发送调度假设不一致,出现固定或可预测的关闭纪元
单向与双向连接状态不匹配:同一会话在两个方向呈现不同的生命周期或状态机行为
连接拆除阶段出现非随机的确定性报文序列或失败模式
defense_advice_zh: 避免将两个独立单向 FEP 直接拼接为双向信道,改用具备跨方向隔离与统一关闭语义的封装层
在协议设计中纳入状态完整性与私有半关闭要求,并对发送调度与关闭时机做随机化
对现网隧道与混淆协议做双向可检测性审计,重点检查流量不平衡与关闭/拆除模式
在流量分析侧建立针对双向相关性的检测基线,用于评估自研协议的整形效果
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进,并纳入内部抗审查/隐私协议设计评估

items.title: XIR: A Framework for Interoperability across Cross-Chain Protocols Based on a Verifiable Intermediate Representation
items.summary: Cross-chain protocols enable applications to exchange messages across blockchains. Under point-to-point configurations, communication depends on a direct connection between the source and destination blockchains, limiting blockchain reachability and requiring additional configurations to connect more blockchains. To quantify this problem, this paper analyzes approximately 25 million mainnet cross-chain transaction events collected from six protocols (Axelar, CCIP, Hyperlane, LayerZero, Relay, and Wormhole) between January and October 2025. The resulting graph covers 286 active blockchains and 11,935 directly connected ordered blockchain pairs. These connections provide a direct reachability of 14.64%, while full direct connectivity would require 81,510 point-to-point configurations. We present XIR, a framework for interoperability across cross-chain protocols based on a verifiable intermediate representation. This representation binds an application message to an ordered record of authenticated cross-chain protocol deliveries, preserving message identity and verification history across protocol boundaries. XIR Gateways and XIR Adapters use this representation to compose existing connections into same-protocol and cross-protocol multi-hop paths. We implement an XIR prototype integrating Hyperlane and LayerZero and evaluate it in local and public-testnet environments. Theoretical analysis and evaluation show that, with correctly configured cross-chain protocol connections, XIR avoids 67,018 additional point-to-point configurations, equivalent to 84.88% of the total required by a point-to-point configuration baseline serving the same reachable pairs, and increases reachability from 14.64% to 96.86% of all ordered blockchain pairs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦跨链协议在点对点（point-to-point）配置下的可达性瓶颈问题。当前跨链消息传递通常依赖源链与目标链之间的直接连接，若要连接更多链，就必须逐对增加配置，导致链上可达性受限、运维复杂度呈组合式增长。为量化这一问题，作者采集并分析了 2025 年 1 月至 10 月期间来自六个主流跨链协议（Axelar、CCIP、Hyperlane、LayerZero、Relay、Wormhole）约 2500 万条主网跨链交易事件，构建出的连接拓扑图覆盖 286 条活跃区块链与 11,935 个有向直连链对。分析显示，这些既有连接仅提供 14.64% 的直接可达性；若要用点对点方式实现全直连，则需要多达 81,510 个点对点配置，成本与治理负担极高。针对该问题，论文提出 XIR——一个基于可验证中间表示（verifiable intermediate representation）的跨链协议互操作框架。该中间表示将应用层消息与一条有序的、经过认证的跨链协议投递记录相绑定，从而在跨越不同协议边界时仍能保持消息身份（message identity）与验证历史（verification history）的完整性，避免消息在多次转发与协议转换过程中被篡改、重放或语义丢失。XIR 通过 XIR Gateway 与 XIR Adapter 两类组件，将已有的跨链连接组合成同协议与跨协议的多跳路径，使原本无直连的链对可以通过既有连接间接互通。作者实现了集成 Hyperlane 与 LayerZero 的 XIR 原型，并在本地环境与公共测试网中进行了评估。理论分析与实验结果一致表明：在跨链协议连接被正确配置的前提下，XIR 可避免 67,018 个额外的点对点配置，相当于服务相同可达链对的点对点基线所需配置总量的 84.88%；同时将所有有向链对的可达性从 14.64% 提升至 96.86%。该工作属于跨链互操作与分布式系统方向的基础性研究，适合跨链协议开发者、桥接与互操作安全研究者、以及负责链上资产跨链风险治理的团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 跨链多跳与跨协议组合会显著扩大信任边界与攻击面：消息身份、验证历史与认证链条若不一致，便可能成为伪造投递、重放或验证降级的温床。XIR 提出的可验证中间表示与多跳路由模型，对桥接安全审计、跨链监控与互操作风险建模具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至跨链桥与互操作中间件的设计评审、多跳消息路径的可验证性验证、跨链监控与告警规则的构建，以及链上资产跨链流转的信任假设梳理等场景。
detection_signals_zh: 同一应用消息在多个跨链协议间被多次投递或出现非预期的多跳路径
跨链事件中源链、中间链与目标链的协议适配器地址组合异常或跳数异常增加
消息标识或验证历史在跨协议转发后发生缺失、重复或被替换
短时间内大量新建的点对点通道配置或适配器注册行为
原本无直连历史的链对之间突然出现高频跨链消息流
defense_advice_zh: 对跨链消息建立端到端路径追踪，记录每一跳的协议、适配器与认证记录，确保可回溯验证历史
对多跳与跨协议组合路径设置独立的风控阈值与人工复核机制，避免信任假设被隐式放大
审计既有跨链连接与适配器配置，确认其是否被正确配置，避免错误配置引入新的信任缺口
在监控中区分同协议多跳与跨协议多跳，对后者给予更高告警优先级
关注消息身份绑定与防重放机制的实现细节，纳入内部桥接安全评估清单
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：将其可验证中间表示的思路纳入跨链互操作与桥接安全的内部评估，并持续关注原型与后续公开实现。

items.title: SEEK: Secure and Efficient Encrypted Keyword Search For Privacy-Preserving Messaging Protocols
items.summary: Encrypted communication protects sensitive user data but can facilitate harmful or unlawful exchanges, creating a trade-off between detecting dangerous messages and preserving end-user privacy. To address this, we propose SEEK, a practical and efficient encrypted keyword-search protocol for privacy-preserving messaging that combines homomorphic encryption with secure two-party computation (2PC). SEEK first partitions messages into ciphertext fragments with the minimum sufficient overlap, then homomorphically correlates them using encrypted keyword trapdoors. For long messages, this design can reduce sender-side encryption and upload overhead by up to two orders of magnitude over state-of-the-art baselines. It supports ASCII case-insensitive matching with one fixed-size encrypted trapdoor and one homomorphic multiplication per fragment, yielding up to 5.47x faster correlation computation than the strongest fragmentation-based baselines. SEEK then invokes 2PC-based selected decoding, blinded zero testing, and secure aggregation, revealing only the keyword presence-or-absence bit while hiding the keyword, its length, message contents, match counts, and locations. SEEK achieves 100% accuracy under case variations that result in exact-matching failures, without requiring additional trapdoors or online communication. We further realize SEEK as an end-to-end web and cross-platform mobile application. Prototype evaluation on a weekly messaging history yields an online computation time of 1.92 s per search, demonstrating the practical feasibility and efficiency of SEEK.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文研究的是端到端加密通信场景下的一个核心矛盾：加密通信保护了用户的敏感数据，但同时也会被用于有害或违法内容的交换，从而在『检测危险消息』与『保护终端用户隐私』之间形成难以调和的权衡。传统做法要么放弃加密做明文审查，要么完全无法检索，作者提出的 SEEK 是一条折中路线：一个实用、高效的加密关键词搜索协议，专门面向隐私保护的即时通信，技术栈由同态加密（HE）与安全两方计算（2PC）两部分组合而成。

协议设计上，SEEK 首先把消息切分为密文片段，并使片段之间只保留『最小充分重叠』，避免冗余；随后用加密的关键词陷门对这些片段做同态相关运算。这一分片策略针对长消息尤其有效，相比当前最先进的基线方案，可将发送端的加密与上传开销降低最多两个数量级。匹配能力上，它用单个固定大小的加密陷门即可支持 ASCII 大小写不敏感匹配，每个片段只需一次同态乘法，相关计算速度比最强的基于分片的基线快最多 5.47 倍。

在结果提取阶段，SEEK 调用基于 2PC 的选择性解码、盲化零测试和安全聚合，使协议只向搜索方泄露『关键词存在或不存在』这一个比特，而关键词本身、关键词长度、消息内容、匹配次数以及匹配位置全部保持隐藏。实验表明，在那些会导致精确匹配失败的大小写变体下，SEEK 仍能达到 100% 准确率，并且无需额外陷门、也不需要额外的在线通信轮次。

作者进一步把 SEEK 实现为端到端的 Web 应用与跨平台移动应用原型。在一周消息历史规模的数据上评估显示，每次搜索的在线计算时间约为 1.92 秒，说明该方案在真实设备与真实数据体量下具备工程可行性。整体而言，这是一篇偏密码协议与信息检索交叉的研究工作，主要贡献在于分片重叠最小化降低开销、单陷门支持大小写不敏感匹配、以及用 2PC 把泄露面压缩到单个比特，适合做隐私计算、E2EE 平台合规审查、以及消息安全检测的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 加密通信平台长期面临『内容安全审查』与『用户隐私』的二选一困境。SEEK 证明了用 HE+2PC 可以在不暴露消息、关键词、匹配次数与位置的前提下，只向审查方返回一个存在性比特，且每周消息历史搜索仅约 1.92 秒。这为 E2EE 产品在合规与儿童安全等场景下提供了可落地的技术路径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到端到端加密即时通信、企业加密邮件/归档系统的合规关键词告警、以及隐私保护的信息检索与日志筛查场景；对需要在不持有明文的前提下做内容风控的服务方具有参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: 客户端出现规律性的、单次约数十秒内完成的本地高 CPU 同态运算峰值，随后伴随一次短时双向 2PC 交互
协议交互中仅出现固定的存在性响应模式，而不返回匹配条目、位置或计数，与常规明文检索服务流量特征明显不同
发送端上行负载显著低于同类加密检索方案，与分片最小重叠设计相符
defense_advice_zh: 将该协议视为隐私增强技术而非检测手段：部署方应明确协议只输出关键词存在性比特，不能据此定位、取证或还原消息内容
在合规评估中同步审查 2PC 对端是否可被日志化、会话是否可重放，以及陷门下发的密钥管理链路
对移动端实现做功耗与本地存储审计，确认同态运算产生的中间密文与陷门不会被落盘或外泄
在威胁建模中纳入『关键词猜测』风险：即使隐藏关键词本身，审查方仍可能通过穷举陷门重复查询，需评估查询频率限制与审计策略
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Detecting Logic Vulnerabilities Across the Contract and Device Layers of Blockchain-Enabled IoT With Multi-Agent Heterogeneous Graph Attention
items.summary: Blockchain-enabled Internet of Things (IoT) systems integrate smart contracts with embedded devices to support decentralized device management and access control. Their security therefore depends jointly on the logic of on-chain contracts and off-chain device firmware. Logic flaws in either layer can violate the same system invariants, such as unauthorized access, improper state changes, or unguarded privileged operations. Existing approaches rely on contract analysis, firmware analysis, and graph-based vulnerability detection. However, these methods typically focus on a single layer or artifact and often depend on predefined vulnerability patterns, emulation fidelity, or homogeneous representations that obscure security-relevant component roles. They also lack a unified architecture that supports different security tasks while remaining deployable on resource-constrained gateways. To address these limitations, we extend MA-HGAT into a cross-layer multi-agent heterogeneous graph attention framework that models contracts, firmware artifacts, device fleets, and transaction streams with a unified four-role, nine-relation schema. Role-aligned agents exchange heterogeneous evidence through cross-attention, while graph-, link-, and node-level heads support multiple detection tasks and a role-based gateway--cloud partition enables lightweight edge inference. MA-HGAT thus provides a unified and deployable framework for detecting logic vulnerabilities across the contract and device layers of blockchain-enabled IoT systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于"区块链赋能物联网"(Blockchain-enabled IoT)系统的跨层逻辑漏洞检测问题。此类系统将链上智能合约与链下嵌入式设备固件结合，用于实现去中心化的设备管理与访问控制，因此其安全性同时取决于合约逻辑与设备固件逻辑两个层面。任一层出现逻辑缺陷都可能破坏同一组系统不变量，典型表现包括未授权访问、状态变更异常、特权操作缺乏保护等。现有方法大致分为合约分析、固件分析和基于图的漏洞检测三类，但作者指出它们存在若干共同局限：通常只针对单一层级或单一制品；依赖预定义的漏洞模式；依赖仿真(firmware emulation)的保真度；或者采用同质(homogeneous)图表示，从而掩盖了不同组件在安全语义中的角色差异。此外，现有工作缺乏一个既能支撑多种安全检测任务、又能在资源受限网关上部署的统一架构。为此，作者将先前的 MA-HGAT 扩展为一个跨层、多智能体的异质图注意力框架：使用统一的"四类角色、九种关系"schema 对合约、固件制品、设备机群(device fleet)与交易流进行建模；角色对齐(role-aligned)的多个智能体通过交叉注意力(cross-attention)交换异质证据；并设置图级、链路级、节点级三类预测头以支持多样化的检测任务。为适应边缘部署，框架采用基于角色的网关—云分区策略，将轻量推理下沉到网关侧。作者将 MA-HGAT 定位为一个统一且可部署的框架，用于检测区块链物联网中合约层与设备层的逻辑漏洞。需要说明的是，摘要中未给出具体数据集、评测指标或量化实验结果，因此其检测效果与性能开销仍需阅读全文验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: IoT+区块链系统的攻击面横跨链上合约与链下固件，单一层级的检测工具容易漏掉跨层逻辑缺陷。该工作提出的异质图多智能体与边缘可部署分区思路，为构建统一跨层检测能力提供了可参考的架构方向。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至区块链物联网网关、智能合约审计平台、固件供应链安全检测、以及需要边缘侧轻量推理的 OT/IoT 安全运营场景；图级/链路级/节点级多任务头也适用于设备机群异常关联分析。
detection_signals_zh: 合约层与固件层对同一系统不变量(如访问控制、状态机合法性)的判定出现不一致
交易流中出现与设备角色不匹配的调用序列或特权操作(privileged operation)被无保护触发
固件制品与链上合约的权限模型、角色定义出现偏移或映射缺失
设备机群中个别节点的行为图与同角色基线出现结构性偏离
链路级(link-level)预测头标记的跨层实体关系异常，例如设备—合约绑定关系异常新增或丢失
defense_advice_zh: 梳理本组织区块链 IoT 系统中的核心安全不变量，明确合约侧与固件侧各自的校验职责与交叉校验点
在网关侧部署轻量推理组件的同时，保留云端对图级/链路级异常的回溯与聚合能力，避免边缘算力受限导致检测降级
建立合约与固件制品的版本关联台账，确保固件升级与合约升级在权限模型上保持同步
将角色化建模思路纳入现有资产管理，按角色而非仅按资产类型定义检测基线与告警分级
对该框架的误报率、时延与资源占用进行独立复现评估后再考虑生产环境试点

items.title: Scaling Zero Knowledge UNSAT Verification via Normalized Chaining
items.summary: Proofs of UNSAT are a standard primitive in formal verification and software assurance. In many real-world settings, the proof itself encodes proprietary or security-sensitive information, making public disclosure undesirable. Zero-knowledge certification of UNSAT addresses this tension: it enables a prover to convince a verifier that no satisfying assignment exists, without revealing anything about the underlying proof beyond its validity. Luo et al. recently introduced ZkUnsat, a protocol that achieves this goal by proving the validity of a weakened resolution proof in zero knowledge. ZkUnsat demonstrates the feasibility of zero-knowledge certification; however, its scalability to larger, real-world instances is constrained by substantial prover memory overhead, limiting its real-world applicability. Motivated by advances in UNSAT proof formats such as LRAT, which enable efficient plain-text verification, we present a preprocessing technique that improves the efficiency of ZkUnsat without introducing additional leakage. Our approach normalizes the proof so that each derived clause is justified by a resolution chain of fixed public length k. This eliminates chain-length leakage and reduces prover memory usage. With k = 16, our method certifies roughly 62% more instances than baseline ZkUnsat on the SAT 2002 competition benchmarks. Furthermore, for an equivalent number of certified instances, the memory footprint drops to under 25% of that required by the baseline.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是形式化验证与软件保障领域中一个长期存在的矛盾：UNSAT（不可满足性）证明是证明程序或硬件设计正确性的标准手段，但在许多真实场景中，证明文件本身会编码专有信息或与安全相关的敏感信息（例如电路结构、约束条件、内部逻辑），因此公开披露证明往往不可接受。零知识 UNSAT 认证正是为缓解这一矛盾而提出的密码学方案：证明者可以在不泄露底层证明任何额外信息（除了'该公式确实不可满足'这一事实）的前提下，让验证者相信不存在满足赋值。Luo 等人此前提出的 ZkUnsat 协议通过'在零知识下证明一个弱化后的归结（resolution）证明有效'来实现这一目标，首次验证了该思路在工程上的可行性。然而论文指出，ZkUnsat 的可扩展性受到严重的证明者内存开销限制，难以处理真实世界中规模较大的实例。作者受 LRAT 等新型 UNSAT 证明格式的启发——这类格式能够让明文验证变得高效——提出一种预处理技术：将证明规范化（normalize），使得每一条推导子句都由固定公开长度 k 的归结链来支撑。这样做带来两个直接收益：一是消除了归结链长度本身所携带的泄露信息（原本链长分布可能隐式暴露证明结构），在不引入额外泄露的前提下提升了保密性；二是显著降低了证明者的内存占用。作者在 SAT 2002 竞赛基准上进行了评估：在 k = 16 的配置下，方法比基线 ZkUnsat 多认证约 62% 的实例；而在认证相同数量实例的前提下，内存占用降至基线的 25% 以下。该工作属于对现有零知识认证协议的效率与可扩展性优化，主要贡献在于预处理层面的规范化构造与实证性的性能提升，适合从事形式化验证、密码学协议、隐私保护证明系统以及供应链/硬件可信验证的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: UNSAT 证明常包含敏感的设计与约束信息，直接公开会泄露知识产权或安全细节。该工作让'不泄露证明内容的正确性认证'在更大规模实例上变得可行，对需要对外证明软件/硬件可信却不愿暴露内部结构的团队具有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到硬件与芯片设计的形式化等价性验证、编译器与智能合约的静态证明、以及需要向第三方或监管方证明'无漏洞/无违例'却不披露内部实现的可信验证流程。内存占用降至基线 25% 以下意味着同等硬件条件下可处理的实例规模显著扩大。
defense_advice_zh: 关注零知识证明系统在形式化验证流程中的落地情况，评估其能否替代明文证明的对外披露
对现有对外提交 UNSAT/SAT 证明的流程做敏感性审计，判断证明文件是否隐含泄露内部约束或设计结构
在引入此类协议时，同步评估其证明者资源开销（内存、时间）对自身验证流水线的容量影响

items.title: Observational Indistinguishability and Integrity Blind Regions in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Workflows
items.summary: We present a claim-relative evidence/reference framework for hybrid quantum-classical workflow integrity. Observational indistinguishability yields structural blind regions, distinct from finite-batch statistical misses. Within the declared lattice, a trusted same-batch scalar $R_0$ suffices for conclusion integrity, aggregate $M_0$ for aggregate plus conclusion integrity, and item-aligned binding for item identity. In 3,600 label interventions, feature/prediction views realize exact label-path invariance; all 764 geometry-aligned aggregate-blind rows equal their paired-clean responses, giving zero attack-only increment. For statistical response, the geometry-aligned construction detects 343/2,700 conclusion-changing ($τ\to 0^+$) label interventions with the conformal rule and 1,183/2,700 with the uncorrected union; the original frozen same-item geometry yields 11/2,617 and 43/2,617, respectively. The executed conformal clean false-action rates are 0.048--0.059 descriptively; its finite-sample guarantee requires exchangeability, which the overlapping-draw design violates. The cluster-preserving adaptive stress test (Gate A) reduces response versus matched controls in 25--40 of 40 environment/split cells while retaining conclusion changes. A bounded 165-design-cell ideal-statevector and finite-shot-emulation branch directly instantiates semantic, estimated and observed kernel transitions. The fixed equal-weight design estimates neither deployment prevalence nor QPU, provider or deployed-service assurance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文面向混合量子—经典（hybrid quantum-classical）计算工作流的完整性（integrity）问题，提出一个“声明相对”（claim-relative）的证据/参照框架，用于严格界定什么样的完整性主张可以被观测证据支持。作者的出发点是一个在安全评估中常被混为一谈的区分：观测不可区分性（observational indistinguishability）会产生结构性的“盲区”（blind regions），这与因批次有限、样本不足导致的统计性漏检（finite-batch statistical miss）在本质上是两回事。框架把完整性主张分层到一个“格”（lattice）上：若只要求结论完整性，一个可信的同批次标量 R0（same-batch scalar）就已足够；若同时要求聚合结果与结论完整性，则需要聚合量 M0；若要保证条目级身份（item identity）不被替换或错配，则需要条目对齐绑定（item-aligned binding）。论文通过大规模受控实验验证上述理论：在 3,600 次标签干预（label intervention）中，特征视图/预测视图实现了精确的标签路径不变性（label-path invariance）；764 行几何对齐的“聚合盲”样本与配对的干净响应完全一致，攻击专属增量（attack-only increment）为零，即这类攻击在观测意义上不可分辨。针对统计性响应能力，几何对齐构造在使用保形（conformal）规则时能在 2,700 次改变结论的标签干预中检出 343 次，使用未校正的并集规则检出 1,183 次；而原始冻结的同条目几何只分别得到 11/2,617 与 43/2,617，说明检测能力高度依赖构造方式与统计校正策略。论文还报告保形规则在有干净数据上的误动作率为 0.048–0.059（描述性），并明确指出其有限样本保证要求样本可交换性（exchangeability），而重叠抽样设计违反了该前提，因此该保证在此不成立。此外，保持聚类结构的自适应压力测试（Gate A）在 40 个环境/划分单元中的 25–40 个里降低了响应比例，同时仍保留结论改变；一个包含 165 个设计单元的有限理想态矢量与有限次采样仿真分支，直接实例化了语义核、估计核与观测核之间的转移。作者最后强调，这个固定等权设计既不能估计真实部署中的攻击流行度，也不能给出对 QPU、供应商或已部署服务的保障性结论。整体而言，这是量子计算与机器学习安全交叉方向上偏方法论与可证明性边界的工作，适合关注完整性证明、审计证据链与统计保证适用条件的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“观测不可区分导致的盲区”与“样本不足导致的漏检”明确区分开，提醒安全团队：某些混合量子—经典流水线中的标签/结果篡改在原理上无法被现有观测证据发现，而保形统计保证在样本可交换性被破坏时并不可靠，直接影响完整性方案的可信度评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到任何“经典后处理 + 量子/加速器执行”的混合流水线审计场景，例如量子机器学习推理服务、云端 QPU 任务提交与结果回传、以及对外部算力供应商的结论完整性验证；也可用于评估现有保形预测/异常检测类完整性监控在抽样耦合设计下的失效边界。
detection_signals_zh: 聚合指标与结论输出出现不一致（聚合一致但结论被改变，或反之）
同一批次内标签路径不变性被违反，或特征/预测视图与预期绑定关系偏离
干净基线上的保形监控误动作率异常升高（论文报告约 0.048–0.059）
抽样设计存在重叠抽取、破坏样本可交换性，使统计保证失效
保持聚类结构的自适应压力测试下响应比例显著低于匹配对照组，而结论改变仍存在
defense_advice_zh: 为完整性主张显式声明其证据层级（仅结论 / 聚合+结论 / 条目身份），不要用低层级证据支撑高层级主张
引入可信的同批次标量 R0 与聚合量 M0 作为交叉校验，并对条目级身份采用对齐绑定，防止错配替换
在使用保形类统计保证前先检验样本可交换性；重叠抽样设计下应视为无保证并改用其他判据
定期运行保持聚类结构的自适应压力测试（对照设计），监测响应比例与结论变化，识别结构性盲区而非仅统计漏检
不要把固定等权实验得到的检出率外推为部署环境中的流行度或供应商安全保障
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.summary: SysReptor is a fully customizable pentest reporting platform. Prior to 2026.58, installations that enable password reset by email while configuring ALLOWED_HOSTS with a wildcard accept an attacker-controlled Host header when generating a password reset link. An unauthenticated attacker can request a reset email whose link points to an attacker-controlled system, and a victim who follows that link can disclose the reset token, allowing the attacker to reset the victim's password and take over the account. Exploitation also requires a configured email gateway and an email address for the victim, while some reverse proxy configurations may reject the hostile Host header. This issue is fixed in version 2026.58.

items.title: Kyoo is a self-hosted media server focused on movies, series, and anime. Prior to 5.1.0, an unauthenticated attacker could initiate the OIDC login flow with an attacker-controll...
items.summary: Kyoo is a self-hosted media server focused on movies, series, and anime. Prior to 5.1.0, an unauthenticated attacker could initiate the OIDC login flow with an attacker-controlled redirectUrl. The login handling in auth/oidc.go stored that URL with the opaque login state, and /auth/oidc/logged/{provider} appended the provider, token, and error values before redirecting the victim's browser without validating the destination. Because the one-use token was not bound to the browser session that initiated login, an attacker who induced a victim to complete OIDC authentication could capture the token at the attacker-controlled destination and exchange it through /auth/oidc/callback/{provider} for the victim's Kyoo session. This issue is fixed in version 5.1.0.

items.summary: Convoy is a cloud native webhooks gateway. Prior to 26.6.8, Convoy's GET /api/v1/projects/{projectID}/sources/{sourceID} endpoint authorizes access to the project in the URL, but Handler.GetSource calls sources.Service.FindSourceByID() and fetches the Source only by sourceID without confirming that its ProjectID matches the authorized project. An authenticated user or project-scoped API key holder can substitute another tenant's Source identifier and receive that Source's complete record, including unredacted AMQP, Kafka, SQS, or Google PubSub credentials. The list endpoint remains project-scoped; the single-item Source lookup is affected. This issue is fixed in version 26.6.8.

items.summary: ToolHive is a utility designed to simplify the deployment and management of Model Context Protocol servers. Prior to ToolHive CLI 0.30.1 and ToolHive Studio 0.38.0, locally run MCP server containers use the default network permission profile without network isolation, permitting access to host.docker.internal while ToolHive API and MCP proxy endpoints are reachable without authentication. A malicious or compromised MCP server can use the Docker gateway to contact host-local services, other ToolHive-managed MCP proxies, or the ToolHive control plane without escaping the container. This access can expose data and logs, invoke sibling MCP tools, alter process or workload state, and disrupt services. ToolHive Studio additionally sends network_isolation as false and overrides the backend's secure isolation default. This issue is fixed in ToolHive CLI 0.30.1 and ToolHive Studio 0.38.0.

When an HTTP/1 request includes both an absolute-form request-target and a conflicting Host header, Netty incorrectly prioritizes the Host header for the HTTP/2 :authority field, discarding the original request-target authority. This inconsistency can allow an attacker to bypass security controls in Netty-based proxies or gateways, potentially leading to unauthorized access, cache poisoning, or misrouting of requests.

items.title: ArcadeDB before 26.9.1 (com.arcadedb:arcadedb-engine <= 26.8.1) fails to bind the authenticated principal onto the DatabaseAsyncTransaction async worker threads used by the para...
items.summary: ArcadeDB before 26.9.1 (com.arcadedb:arcadedb-engine <= 26.8.1) fails to bind the authenticated principal onto the DatabaseAsyncTransaction async worker threads used by the parallel edge-connect phase of POST /api/v1/batch/{database}. Because those workers have no current user, LocalDatabase.checkPermissionsOnFile returns early and allows the write, bypassing per-type CREATE_RECORD/UPDATE_RECORD ACL enforcement. In deployments that rely on per-type or per-group ACLs, an authenticated low-privilege user holding CREATE_RECORD on an edge type E but with CREATE_RECORD/UPDATE_RECORD revoked on a vertex type V can submit a graph edge-load batch request (with parallelFlush at its default value of true) and durably append edges to protected vertices of type V by writing records into V's <V>_out_edges/<V>_in_edges buckets, resulting in unauthorized modification of graph adjacency. items.title:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

batman-adv: bla: avoid CRC corruption due to parallel claim add

batadv_bla_add_claim() is used to add claim...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

batman-adv: bla: avoid CRC corruption due to parallel claim add

batadv_bla_add_claim() is used to add claims and modify the backbone of
claims for CLAIM frames from remote backbones and local packets. When it
handles a claim, it needs to either

* add the new claim's CRC to the backbone CRC
* remove the already existing claim's CRC from the old backbone and add it
  to the new backbone

But when the "new" claim code was running in parallel to the "change
backbone" code, it can happen that the CRC was invalid because the
backbone_gw of the claim was changed twice in the "new" claim code path:

* CPU0 creates the claim for gateway A and publishes it in the claim
  hash. The crc16 of the address has not yet been added to A's crc at
  this point.

* CPU1 processes a claim frame of gateway B for the same client, finds
  the just published claim, and performs the ownership change: it
  switches the pointer to B, removes the crc16 from A's crc - which
  never contained it - and adds it to B's crc.

* CPU0 continues behind the creation branch, unconditionally switches
  the pointer back to A without compensating B's crc (its remove_crc
  is false for the creation path), and finally adds the crc16 to A's
  crc

The CRC is then wrong for both:

* claim belongs to A: but CRC is not part of backbone A's CRC
* claim doesn't belong to B: CRC is still part of backbone B's CRC

This wrong CRC is never recomputated from the stored claims. For local
backbone claims, this can also not recovered using syncs.

To avoid this, split the functionality in clear separate parts:

* new claim which always adds claim CRC to the backbone CRC (but never
  changes the already set backbone_gw of the claim back)

* update of existing claim which automatically changes the backbone_gw
  entry and only updates both backbone CRCs when there was an actual change

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

nfc: nci: fix double completion race in nci_data_exchange_complete

nci_close_device() and nci_rx_work can b...
items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

nfc: nci: fix double completion race in nci_data_exchange_complete

nci_close_device() and nci_rx_work can both call
nci_data_exchange_complete() concurrently.  After commit 4527025d440ce8
("nfc: nci: fix circular locking dependency in nci_close_device") moved
flush_workqueue(ndev->rx_wq) after mutex_unlock(&ndev->req_lock),
rx_work is no longer serialized with the explicit completion call in the
close path.  Both callers read the non-NULL callback pointer and invoke
rawsock_data_exchange_complete(), which calls sock_put() -- but only one
sock_hold() was taken, so the second sock_put() underflows the refcount
and frees the socket while it is still in use.

Replace the bare clear_bit(NCI_DATA_EXCHANGE) with
test_and_clear_bit() so that only the first caller proceeds to invoke
the callback.

items.title: Initializing the DNS stub resolver from an /etc/resolv.conf file, or a LOCALDOMAIN environment variable, whose search list contains a domain of roughly 200 characters or more in...
items.summary:
Initializing the DNS stub resolver from an /etc/resolv.conf file, or a LOCALDOMAIN environment variable, whose search list contains a domain of roughly 200 characters or more in the GNU C Library version 2.26 to 2.44 results in an assertion failure which aborts the process.

The resolver truncates the search list when copying it into the fixed-size _res.defdname buffer, then asserts that the copy is consistent with the full configuration.  The consistency check compared against the wrong size and did not handle a first entry that does not fit, so a correctly truncated list failed the assertion.  Any process that resolves names through the library is affected, including long-running processes that reload /etc/resolv.conf on the next query after it changes.  Search domains are commonly written to /etc/resolv.conf from data received over DHCP or from a VPN server, so an attacker on the local network may be able to trigger this without privileges on the target system, subject to validation by the network configuration software.

items.summary: The AsyncHttpClient (AHC) library allows Java applications to easily execute HTTP requests and asynchronously process HTTP responses. From 3.0.8 until 3.0.12, processScramAuthenticationInfo and processAuthenticationInfo compute the SCRAM ServerSignature or Digest rspauth verification result but log a mismatch and still deliver the response as authenticated. On a non-TLS or compromised transport, a peer that has not proved knowledge of the shared secret can therefore be accepted as the server. The fix rejects a present invalid value and computes Digest rspauth from the Authorization parameters actually sent, but verification remains unenforced when the value is absent, the sent parameters cannot be recovered, or Digest uses qop=auth-int. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.12.

items.title: c-ares: CPU-exhaustion denial of service via unbounded DNS name compression pointer chains
items.summary: c-ares is an asynchronous resolver library. Prior to 1.34.7, ares_dns_name_parse() enforces backward DNS compression pointers but does not bound the total pointer hops or assembled name length. A malicious DNS server can send a response containing a long descending pointer chain and many resource records whose NAME or RDATA fields refer to the chain, causing repeated decompression work that grows quadratically with message size. A single crafted response can stall the single-threaded c-ares event loop and deny DNS resolution, without causing memory corruption or information disclosure. This issue is fixed in version 1.34.7.

items.title: Kyoo: Transcoder serves uncataloged files from the media directory
items.summary: Kyoo is a self-hosted media server focused on movies, series, and anime. Prior to 5.1.0, a registered user with the core.play permission could supply a base64-encoded filesystem path to the transcoder. The path handling in transcoder/src/api/path.go cleaned the value and checked only that it began with Settings.SafePath before getHash processed it, while transcoder/src/api/streams.go served the accepted path without verifying a Kyoo catalog record. This missing catalog-level authorization allowed the user to retrieve hidden, temporary, operational, or other uncataloged files beneath the media directory when the path was known or guessed. This vulnerability is fixed in 5.1.0.

items.title: PJSIP: Heap buffer overflow in the AVI parser
items.summary: PJSIP is a free and open source multimedia communication library written in C. In 2.17 and earlier, the PJSIP AVI parser in pjmedia/src/pjmedia/avi_player.c uses an input-file video chunk length as the number of bytes copied into a frame buffer whose capacity is derived from the declared media dimensions. A crafted AVI file can therefore cause an attacker-controlled out-of-bounds write past the heap allocation when an application plays the file or pulls its frames. The existing size assertion does not protect production release builds, where assertions are disabled. Typical local playback can crash the process, while applications that accept untrusted AVI sources expose a stronger memory-corruption condition. No fixed version is available as of this review.

items.title: AnyIO process-pool workers can block indefinitely on undrained stderr
items.summary: AnyIO is a high level asynchronous concurrency and networking framework that works on top of either Trio or asyncio. Worker code that writes enough attacker-influenced data to sys.stderr can fill the pipe and block before returning the standard-output protocol response, causing the awaiting process-pool call to remain blocked indefinitely. Applications that run untrusted or faulty worker code capable of producing substantial standard-error output are affected. This issue is fixed in version 4.14.2.

items.title: LMDeploy has Remote Code Execution by Pickle Deserialization via handle_zmq_recv in lmdeploy/lmdeploy/pytorch/disagg/conn/engine_conn.py
items.summary: LMDeploy is a toolkit for compressing, deploying, and serving large language models. Starting in version 0.9.2 and prior to version 0.16.0, LMDeploy's PyTorch DistServe/PD-disaggregation control plane used `recv_pyobj()` to deserialize messages received through a ZeroMQ PULL socket. PyZMQ implements `recv_pyobj()` using Python pickle deserialization, which can execute arbitrary code while reconstructing an object. The peer address used by the receiver was supplied through the `POST /distserve/p2p_connect` HTTP endpoint. An attacker who could reach an affected DistServe API server could cause the server to connect to an attacker-controlled ZeroMQ endpoint and deserialize a crafted pickle payload. API-key authentication is not enabled unless the operator explicitly configures it. As a result, affected DistServe deployments without API keys allowed unauthenticated remote code execution with the privileges of the LMDeploy serving process. This issue affects the PyTorch backend when PD-disaggregation/DistServe is enabled. Ordinary deployments that do not use the affected disaggregated-serving path do not expose this data flow. The fix was released in LMDeploy 0.16.0. Users who cannot upgrade immediately should prevent untrusted clients from reaching `/distserve/*` endpoints, restrict the DistServe HTTP and ZeroMQ control planes to trusted cluster networks, configure API-key authentication, and block arbitrary outbound ZeroMQ connections from serving nodes. These measures reduce exposure but do not make pickle deserialization safe.

items.title: Cocos AI: Intra-handshake attested TLS implementation can accept Evidence with nil, empty, or omitted reportData in the AMD SEV-SNP path
items.summary: Cocos AI is a confidential computing system for running AI workloads inside trusted execution environments. In versions up to and including 0.8.2, the intra-handshake attested TLS (aTLS) AMD SEV-SNP verification path does not enforce attestation freshness when the expected reportData value is nil, empty, or omitted, leaving the SEV-SNP policy ReportData unset so the verifier accepts unrelated or stale Evidence not bound to the current connection. A relying party that uses this path without an expected reportData as a trust or authorization decision can be induced to trust an unintended attestation context; a supplied non-empty reportData is still validated. items.title: AnyIO run_process/open_process ignores extra_groups and can retain parent supplementary groups
items.summary: AnyIO is a high level asynchronous concurrency and networking framework that works on top of either Trio or asyncio. In 4.14.0, AnyIO accepts the POSIX extra_groups argument in anyio.run_process() and anyio.open_process(), but open_process() forwards the group argument to the backend instead of extra_groups. A caller that supplies extra_groups=[] to clear inherited supplementary groups can therefore launch a child that retains the parent process groups, undermining a privilege-dropping boundary. If group is also supplied, the integer group value is passed where an iterable of supplementary groups is expected and the launch can fail with TypeError. This issue affects POSIX applications that rely on AnyIO subprocess helpers to launch less-privileged child processes. This issue is fixed in version 4.14.2.

items.title: zot: Bearer authentication maps DELETE to push scope, allowing unauthorized deletion
items.summary: zot is a container image and artifact registry based on the Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification. Prior to 2.1.18, the bearer authentication handler in pkg/api/authn.go maps every HTTP method other than GET and HEAD to the push action, so DELETE requests are not checked for the distinct delete permission. Bearer-authenticated requests also bypass the fine-grained DistSpecAuthzHandler path in pkg/api/authz.go, while DeleteManifest and DeleteBlob perform no independent delete-permission check. A remote attacker with a bearer token limited to pull and push actions can therefore delete manifests and blobs within the token's repository scope, making images unavailable and allowing repository history to be altered despite the token lacking delete authorization. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.18.

items.title: Semantic MediaWiki has a query debug output XSS (`DebugFormatter`)
items.summary: Semantic MediaWiki is a free, open-source extension to MediaWiki that lets users store and query data within the wiki's pages. Prior to version 7.2.0, query debug output (`format=debug`, or the `debug` request parameter on `Special:Ask`) is assembled by `SMW\Query\DebugFormatter` and emitted as raw HTML. Several of its sinks apply no output-context encoding, so attacker-controlled query input is reflected into the page without escaping. On `Special:Ask` the resulting string is concatenated into the page and sent through `OutputPage::addHTML`, never through the MediaWiki parser or Sanitizer. No special user right is required; an anonymous request suffices. This is a reflected XSS: the payload is taken from the request and echoed in the same response. Exploitation requires the query condition to target a text/blob-typed property (whose value is re-serialized verbatim); the predefined `_txt` properties (`Text`, etc.) that ship on every install satisfy this, so no attacker-created content is needed. Version 7.2.0 patches the issue.

items.title: AnyCable: Telemetry Subsystem Contains Hardcoded Authentication Token and Transmits CLI Arguments Including Secrets
items.summary: AnyCable is a realtime server for reliable two-way communication that supports any backend. These inputs are passed to generateDigest, where sha256.New produces the hexadecimal fingerprint that is sent as telemetry. The available source therefore does not show raw credentials leaving the process or establish the advisory's claimed confidentiality loss, although the stable fingerprint is derived from secret-bearing configuration and the default telemetry client uses publicly known authentication material. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.15.

items.title: AnyCable: Pusher REST API Does Not Verify Request Body MD5 Enabling Signed-Request Replay with Arbitrary Body
items.summary: AnyCable is a realtime server for reliable two-way communication that supports any backend. Prior to 1.6.15, the Pusher-compatible REST API in pusher/http.go includes the caller-supplied body_md5 value in the HMAC input but does not calculate the digest of the received request body or compare it with the signed value. An attacker who obtains a legitimate signed POST request can retain its query parameters and auth_signature while replacing the body, causing Handler and handleEvents to accept and broadcast attacker-selected event content. The absence of an auth_timestamp freshness check also allows the captured signature to be replayed indefinitely. This can forge server-side events, modify application state, or deliver attacker-controlled messages to WebSocket clients within the signed request's application context. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.15.

items.title: NanoMQ: Heap-Buffer-Overflow in `nmq_subinfo_decode()` During MQTT v5 SUBSCRIBE Parsing
items.summary: NanoMQ is an MQTT broker. Prior to 0.24.14, NanoMQ's broker-side MQTT v5 nmq_subinfo_decode() function in nng/src/sp/protocol/mqtt/mqtt_parser.c reuses len_of_varint from the outer Properties Length while parsing each SUBSCRIPTION_IDENTIFIER. A remote client can send a SUBSCRIBE packet with a multi-byte Properties Length and repeated subscription identifiers, causing get_var_integer() to begin at an incorrect offset and read beyond the heap message buffer. The flaw is reachable through the broker receive path and can crash the broker, while the separately reported topic-option off-by-one occurs later and is not this vulnerability. This issue is fixed in version 0.24.14.

items.title: NanoMQ: Infinite Loop in UNSUBSCRIBE Decoder Leading to Remote DoS

items.title: NanoMQ: O(N²) Denial of Service in MQTT v5 Property Parsing

A remote unauthenticated client can supply a PUBLISH or SUBSCRIBE packet containing many User Properties, causing O(N²) linked-list insertion and CPU work that makes the broker unresponsive; repeated packets can sustain the denial of service. items.title: Mojolicious: CSRF tokens are vulnerable to BREACH attacks
items.summary: Mojolicious is a real-time web framework for Perl. Prior to 9.48, the Mojolicious CSRF helpers csrf_field, csrf_token, and csrf_protect reuse an unchanged per-session token in rendered HTML. When response compression is enabled and attacker-influenced content is reflected in the same response, an unauthenticated attacker who can induce many victim requests and observe response sizes can use a BREACH compression side channel to recover the token and forge cross-site requests. API-only deployments that never render the token in HTML are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 9.48.

items.title: libheif: Heap out-of-bounds read in libheif inline-mask region API (heif_region_item_add_region_inline_mask_data / heif_region_get_mask_image)
items.summary: libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. Prior to 1.23.2, the public heif_region_item_add_region_inline_mask_data() function in libheif/api/libheif/heif_regions.cc accepts mask_data_len without verifying that it equals the byte count required by width and height. A later heif_region_get_mask_image() call derives the read length from the region geometry, so an undersized stored buffer causes heif_region_get_inline_mask_image() to read beyond the heap allocation and copy adjacent bytes into the returned monochrome mask image. This can disclose heap data or crash an application that constructs region metadata through the writer API, while the file-parsing path is not affected because it validates the canonical mask size. This issue is fixed in version 1.23.2.

items.title: org.xwiki.rendering:xwiki-rendering-xml has an Eval Injection issue
items.summary: XWiki Rendering is a generic rendering system that converts textual input in a given syntax (wiki syntax, HTML, etc) into another syntax (XHTML, etc). Prior to versions 14.10.2 and 15.0 RC1, any user who can edit their own user profile or any other document can execute arbitrary script macros including Groovy and Python macros that allow remote code execution including unrestricted read and write access to all wiki contents. The reason is that rendering output is included as content of HTML macros without further escaping and it is thus possible to close the HTML macro and inject script macros that are executed with programming rights. This has been patched in XWiki 14.10.2 and 15.0 RC1 by making sure that rendering output cannot close the surrounding HTML macro. A possible workaround is available. It is, in principle, possible to add escaping to all places where rendering output is used in wiki documents, but at the moment there is no list of them.
